training.positive: A head-and-shoulders photograph of a strikingly attractive 29-year-old woman with short, dark, spiky hair, one unruly spike falling forward. She wears a faded black T-shirt and a small silver ear cuff. Her head is tilted slightly, one expressive eyebrow cocked. A crooked, toothy grin catches her just before she laughs; her nose scrunches a little and her bright eyes look amused, as if she just got away with something. Beautifully defined cheekbones, an appealing jawline, expressive lips, a few freckles and natural skin texture. Distinctive, charming, full of personality. Soft window light, a blurred green wall behind her.
training.negative: A head-and-shoulders photograph of a 29-year-old woman with short, dark, spiky hair. She wears a faded black T-shirt and a small silver ear cuff. Her head is tilted slightly, one eyebrow raised, a sideways grin on her face as she looks at the camera. Unflattering facial rendering, poorly defined features, dull unfocused eyes, a stiff and awkward grin, waxy skin. Her expression feels forced and lifeless. Soft window light, a blurred green wall behind her.
